mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILYLOOKS (dailylook_id, user_id, wear_date, description, file_id, canvas_json, created_by, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{dailylookId}, #{userId}, TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{description}, #{fileId}, #{canvasJson}, #{userId}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO DAILYLOOK_ITEMS ( DAILYLOOK_ID, CLOTHES_ID, USER_ID, WEAR_DATE, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{dailylookId}, #{clothesId}, #{userId}, TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT dailylook_id AS dailylookId, user_id AS userId, wear_date AS wearDate, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM DAILYLOOKS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' OR IS_ACTIVE IS NULL) AND wear_date = TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILYLOOKS SET description = #{description}, file_id = #{fileId}, canvas_json = #{canvasJson}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE dailylook_id = #{dailylookId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM dailylooks WHERE SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')

SELECT C.CLOTHES_ID AS clothesId, C.NAME AS name, FI.S3_URL AS imageUrl, COUNT(*) AS wearCount FROM DAILYLOOK_ITEMS DI JOIN DAILYLOOKS D ON DI.DAILYLOOK_ID = D.DAILYLOOK_ID JOIN CLOTHES C ON DI.CLOTHES_ID = C.CLOTHES_ID LEFT JOIN CLOTHES_IMAGES CI ON CI.CLOTHES_ID = C.CLOTHES_ID LEFT JOIN FILE_INFO FI ON CI.FILE_ID = FI.FILE_ID WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND (C.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' OR C.IS_ACTIVE IS NULL) GROUP BY C.CLOTHES_ID, C.NAME, FI.S3_URL ORDER BY wearCount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.CLOTHES_ID AS clothesId, C.NAME AS name, FI.S3_URL AS imageUrl, COUNT(*) AS wearCount FROM DAILYLOOK_ITEMS DI JOIN DAILYLOOKS D ON DI.DAILYLOOK_ID = D.DAILYLOOK_ID JOIN CLOTHES C ON DI.CLOTHES_ID = C.CLOTHES_ID LEFT JOIN CLOTHES_IMAGES CI ON CI.CLOTHES_ID = C.CLOTHES_ID LEFT JOIN FILE_INFO FI ON CI.FILE_ID = FI.FILE_ID WHERE D.USER_ID = #{userId} AND D.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(D.WEAR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY C.CLOTHES_ID, C.NAME, FI.S3_URL ORDER BY wearCount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
